# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 1       | **✓** |

## Reporting a Vulnerability
If you are messing around trying to crack the  payload and somehow discover a linear weakness or a math flaw in the equation, please do not open a public issue. 

Instead, contact me via the email listed on my profile. The email subject must begin with the [SECURITY] tag, for example: "[SECURITY] Subject text goes here".
